105-migration-flow-chord.visual_critic_note: Dark-background chord diagram paired with a stacked area chart is a deliberate, cohesive layout with a restrained but harmonious regional palette; the chord interior is slightly muddy and the region labels at small angles are hard to read, but overall the design feels intentional and polished.
105-migration-flow-chord.encoding_integrity_note: Stacked area has zero baseline and data-driven y-domain via d3.max; chord arcs/ribbons encode flow proportionally; keyed data joins present; minor deduction for unseeded Math.random() synthetic matrices that change on each load, preventing consistent validation.
105-migration-flow-chord.stress_test_note: Slider input fires drawChord(true) with 800ms transitions on every event with no .interrupt() call, causing mid-transition conflicts when dragged; no debounce/RAF coalescing guards the chord+area re-renders.
105-migration-flow-chord.cognitive_load_note: The hover-to-highlight interaction manages the dense 56-ribbon chord well, but the static state reads as a moderate tangle and the 8-color palette (at the warning threshold) makes matching stacked area bands to legend entries slow without hovering.
